Name: pairwise_removal_interaction_audit
Title: Removal Is Not Additive: Interaction, Copy Count and Seed Cost of Per-Item Credit on Natural and Manufactured Retrieved Sets in a Multi-Step Agent
Short Hypothesis: In ALFWorld with a Qwen3-32B reader and k=3 retrieval, the counterfactual value of a retrieved item is not an item property: it depends on what is co-retrieved with it, and it does so often enough in the retriever's own sets that per-item credit is estimator-dependent. Three claims, each with a named refuting arm. (i) NATURAL (headline): on the retriever's own top-3 sets, single-removal (leave-one-out, LOO) credit and exact Shapley credit computed on disjoint seed halves agree less than two LOO estimates agree with each other, and LOO's top item differs from Shapley's in >= 20% of sets net of the seed-noise floor; a rank-1-dominated, additive retrieval distribution (cross-estimator agreement at least as high as within-estimator agreement) refutes it. (ii) SIGN: on manufactured pairs beside a natural third item, the pairwise interaction I(a,b) = f(S) - f(S-a) - f(S-b) + f(S-ab) on the same (game, seed) is negative for a correct plus a planted conflicting same-type procedure (the wrong item dominates and masks the correct item's value; additive reconciliation gives I ~ 0 and correct-item rescue gives a positive I the size of the wrong item's harm), positive for two complementary fragments, and zero within a pre-registered equivalence bound for a cross-type control. (iii) DOSE: copy count is inert: two content-identical paraphrase copies of the rank-1 item add <= +2 net over the item alone, so the +8 net that natural items 2-3 add over item 1 (Measurement C: k3 - k1) is content, not repetition; amplification of >= +8 net refutes it. The number of seeds at which a per-item removal rank stabilizes is an estimand measured on 8-seed split halves, not a footnote.
Related Work: CUE-R (arxiv:2604.05467) measures REMOVE/REPLACE/DUPLICATE per evidence item in single-shot RAG and reports non-additive multi-hop interactions, but no multi-step agent, no pairwise-removal estimand and no run-to-run variance or cost. Shapley source attribution in RAG (arxiv:2507.04480) compares SHAP approximations to exact document attributions under redundancy/complementarity/synergy on QA, without stochastic-evaluation noise or agents. The scaffold-level 2^5 factorial (arxiv:2605.05716) finds 56% submodularity violations among components, not among retrieved items. DG-Mem (arxiv:2608.23268) uses Shapley context attribution over memory entries as a component of a multimodal agentic learner and does not test additivity or estimator noise. RoMeRL (arxiv:2608.02508) posits contamination of co-retrieved memories by jointly assigned rewards without a counterfactual check; MemQ (arxiv:2605.08374) leaves credit splitting among co-retrieved siblings open. The compliance trap (arxiv:2607.10608) shows early adoption of conflicting memory but never varies the co-retrieved set. Formal home: Shapley interaction indices (shapiq arxiv:2410.01649; joint Shapley arxiv:2107.11357). Archived: counterfactual_memory_screening_under_selection_noise (5.45) assumed its interference and noise model; retrieved_set_disagreement_gate (4.65) claimed set-level harm without item-level ground truth. This proposal measures interference with the pairwise cell on manufactured classes and on the retriever's own sets, copy count with a content-held-fixed dose arm (CUE-R's DUPLICATE is its single-shot nearest neighbour), and estimator noise with no-op repeats and disjoint seed halves, with stated power per cell.
Abstract: Every self-evolving memory system scores its items, but a per-item score is meaningful only if an item's value is an item property. We test the weakest form of that assumption, additivity of removal effects, in a multi-step agent, and we test it where it matters: on the sets the retriever actually returns. On ALFWorld with a Qwen3-32B reader and k=3 retrieval from the expert bank we run, on the same (game, seed), the full 2^3 subset lattice of the natural top-3 set plus a no-op repeat, and compute leave-one-out (LOO) and exact Shapley credit on disjoint seed halves. The headline estimand is the excess of cross-estimator over within-estimator disagreement: under additivity Shapley equals LOO cell by cell and, being less noisy, can only agree better, so any excess is interaction in the wild. Mechanism cells manufacture the interaction classes beside a natural third item (correct + planted conflicting procedure; two complementary fragments; helpful + cross-type control) and predict class-specific signs, with the conflict cell framed as a dominance test whose refuting outcome (the correct item rescues the harmed baseline, I positive) is as reachable as its confirming one. A dose arm holds content fixed and varies copy count (one versus three paraphrase copies of the rank-1 item, and of a procedure-deleted degraded copy) to decide whether the measured +8 net marginal value of items 2-3 is content or repetition. An 8-seed subsample gives the split-half reliability of per-item credit as a function of seed count and the LLM-call cost of LOO versus Shapley at matched reliability. Item credit is reported net of Measurement C's static3 arm and under a second background. The result is a measured rather than assumed interference model that says how often per-item credit in an experience bank is well-defined, which estimator to trust, and what a reliable estimate costs in re-runs.
Experiments: (1) Materials: expert bank; k-sweep retrieval logs (runs/sweep/k_sweep_final.jsonl) for the valid games and the same retriever applied to bank-disjoint train-stream games; Qwen3-32B reader on two vLLM replicas (one per GPU, clients spread across both). Games: all procedure-bound types (clean/heat/cool) in valid_seen+valid_unseen (~140) plus ~160 bank-disjoint train-stream games of the same types (partition verified before pre-registration) = 300 games. Natural items r1, r2, r3 = the retriever's rank 1-3 for the game. Cell tiers, nested so subsets are shared across arms: Tier A = 300 games x 6 seeds = 1,800 paired cells (+/-3.5 net); Tier N = 200 of those games (140 valid + 60 train-stream) x 6 seeds = 1,200 cells (+/-4 net); Tier B = the same 200 games x 4 seeds = 800 cells (+/-5 net); Tier S = 100 of the Tier N games x seeds 7-8 (with seeds 1-6 from Tier N, an 8-seed subsample). (2) Manufactured items, each token-matched to the item it replaces and placed in that item's retrieval-rank slot: p1, p2 = Qwen3-32B paraphrases of r1 with identical action sequence (exact action-string match after paraphrase); b_c = planted wrong-procedure item for the task type (clean: heats instead of using the sink; heat: uses the fridge; cool: uses the microwave); b_x = cross-type expert item; c1 = find-and-take fragment of a same-type expert episode cut before the procedure step, c2 = procedure-and-place fragment from another same-type episode with the same receptacle, jointly token-matched to one item; d = paraphrase of r1 with the procedure step deleted (find/take/place kept); f1, f2 = cross-type filler items (same construction as b_x); x' = natural cross-type item for the BACKGROUND arm. (3) Runs per (game, seed) cell, listing only non-shared runs. Tier A: (r3), (r1 r3), (r1); CONFLICT (r1 b_c r3), (b_c r3), no-op repeat (r1 b_c r3)'; CONTROL (r1 b_x r3), (b_x r3), repeat (r1 b_x r3)'; DOSE (r1 p1 p2). Tier N: NATURAL lattice (), (r2), (r1 r2), (r2 r3), (r1 r2 r3), repeat (r1 r2 r3)' (with (r1), (r3), (r1 r3) from Tier A this is the full 2^3 lattice); COMPLEMENTARY (c1 c2 r3), (c2 r3), (c1 r3), repeat (c1 c2 r3)', with (r3) shared. Tier B: position swap (b_c r1 r3); degraded dose (d), (d d' d''); slot-count reference (r1 f1 f2); BACKGROUND (r1 b_c x'), (b_c x'), (r1 x'), (x'); STATIC = Measurement C's static3 (3 fixed type-conditioned exemplars, cached) plus (r1 b_c r3), (b_c r3), (r1 r3). CONFLICT Shapley completion (b_c), (r1 b_c) on 100 games x 4 seeds = 400 cells. Tier S: all 8 natural subsets on seeds 7-8. (4) Phase 0 gates on the first 400 Tier A cells (200 games x 2 seeds), run before the rest: f(r3) - f(b_c r3) >= +10 net with CI excluding 0, else b_c is revised; f(r1 r3) - f(r3) >= +8 net with CI excluding 0, else (pre-registered fallback) the manufactured sets use an empty third slot; (p1) alone versus (r1) on 200 cells, with exact action-string match as the hard criterion (the surviving REDUNDANT construction check). (5) Episode arithmetic: Tier A 3 + 3 + 3 + 1 = 10 runs x 1,800 = 18,000; Tier N 6 + 4 = 10 runs x 1,200 = 12,000; Tier B 1 + 2 + 1 + 4 + 3 = 11 runs x 800 = 8,800; CONFLICT completion 2 x 400 = 800; Tier S 8 x 200 = 1,600; Phase 0 extra 200. Total 41,400 episodes ~ 35 h at the measured 20 ep/min on two A100s (~1.5 days with errored re-runs), under nohup with pid files and resumable append-only JSONL, workers tuned to the vLLM running queue. Pre-registered cut order if wall-clock must shrink to the original 27 h: STATIC (2,400), position swap (800), Tier S (1,600), COMPLEMENTARY to Tier B (1,600), BACKGROUND (3,200). (6) Analysis: per-class mean I with cluster bootstrap by game (1,000 resamples) and pre-registered equivalence bounds (TOST); phi_LOO(i) = f(S) - f(S-i) and exact Shapley phi_SH(i) from the 8 subsets; cross- versus within-estimator agreement on disjoint seed halves (A = seeds 1-3, B = seeds 4-6 on Tier N; seeds 1-4 versus 5-8 on Tier S); split-half reliability of per-item LOO at 1, 2, 3 and 4 seeds per half with Spearman-Brown correction; LLM-call cost per unit reliability for LOO (4 runs per set), LOO + pairs (7) and Shapley (8); all item credits also reported with static3 present and per task type.
Baselines and Ablations: Additive model (I = 0; predict f(S-ab) from the other three cells) as the null for every class and for the natural lattice; DIG-style single-item confidence gain (log-prob of the first procedure-relevant action with vs without the item, one forward pass) as the cheap proxy, scored by rank correlation against LOO and Shapley on the natural items; position swap (b_c r1 r3) to separate slot from content in the CONFLICT sign; slot-count reference (r1 f1 f2) and the degraded copy (d) for the dose arm; no-op repeats as the intervention-free noise floor and disjoint seed halves as the estimator floor (LOO-vs-LOO, Shapley-vs-Shapley); second background (x' cross-type) for the CONFLICT class; static3 arm (Measurement C) to net out type-level credit; CONFLICT Shapley completion on 400 cells as the positive control that a per-class LOO-vs-Shapley excess is detectable when interaction is planted; Phase 0 paraphrase check (p1 vs r1) as the construction check that survives from the REDUNDANT class; per-type reporting (clean/heat/cool).
Falsifiable Predictions: P1 NATURAL (headline). Arm: the 2^3 lattice of the retriever's own top-3 set on 200 games x 6 seeds, LOO and exact Shapley computed on disjoint seed halves A = seeds 1-3 and B = seeds 4-6. Prediction: Spearman(phi_LOO on A, phi_SH on B), averaged with its mirror, over the 600 natural items is <= Spearman(phi_LOO on A, phi_LOO on B) - 0.15; and on the 100-game 8-seed subsample (LOO on seeds 1-4, Shapley on seeds 5-8) LOO's top item differs from Shapley's in >= 20% of sets net of the LOO(1-4)-vs-LOO(5-8) floor. Falsified if the cross-estimator agreement is >= the within-LOO agreement (under additivity phi_SH = phi_LOO in every cell and the less noisy Shapley can only agree better, expected cross agreement sqrt(rho_LOO x rho_SH) >= rho_LOO), or if the net top-item disagreement is < 5 points: the retriever's sets are rank-1-dominated and effectively additive, and LOO is as good as Shapley. Primary statistic (i) at 600 items (game-bootstrap SE of the correlation gap ~0.05, gap 0.15 = 3 SE); (ii) at 100 sets (SE ~5 points, gap 15 = 3 SE) is the decision-relevant secondary. Not entailed: the natural interaction terms are unmeasured, and the k3 - k1 = +8 net marginal is compatible with both additive and interacting sets. P2 CONFLICT (Tier A, +/-3.5 net). I = f(r1 b_c r3) - f(b_c r3) - f(r1 r3) + f(r3) <= -8 net: the planted wrong item dominates when both are present and masks the correct item's solo value. Falsified if I >= 0: additive reconciliation (I ~ 0) or correct-item dominance (I ~ +harm(b_c) >= +10 net: the reader follows r1 in slot 1 and rescues the b_c-harmed baseline). Both refuting outcomes are reachable under the Phase 0 gates, which fix only the extremes (harm(b_c) >= 10, gain(r1 | r3) >= 8) and not which item the reader follows; gap 8 > CI half-width. The position swap (b_c r1 r3) separates slot-1 dominance from content dominance (I_swap - I at ~+/-6 net, reported). P3 COMPLEMENTARY (Tier N, +/-4 net). I >= +8 net (AND structure: neither fragment alone carries the procedure). Falsified if I <= +2 net: the prior (k=0 success 0.54) or the natural r3 completes the missing half so each fragment alone retains most of the gain; gap 6 > 4. P4 CONTROL (Tier A, +/-3.5 net). |I| <= 3 net with the 95% CI inside the pre-registered equivalence bound [-6, +6] (TOST). Falsified if I <= -9 net (the cross-type item distracts at the first decision point and masks at least 60% of r1's solo gain; blind1's -3 net under k0 makes this reachable) or I >= +9; the bound exceeds the CI half-width and the falsifier lies 6.5 net beyond the confirm band. P5 DOSE (Tier A, +/-3.5 net). Delta_add = f(r1 p1 p2) - f(r1) <= +2 net with CI inside [-6, +6]: content-identical copies are inert, so the +8 net that natural items 2-3 add over item 1 is content, not repetition. Falsified if Delta_add >= +8 net (repetition amplification: two content-free copies reproduce the natural marginal value of items 2-3, as repeated exposure in the compliance trap would give) or <= -8 (repetition harm). Reachable because adoption of r1 at k=1 is far from saturated (k1 - k0 ~ +21 net, k3 - k1 = +8), and decoupled from any Phase 0 gate. Secondary (Tier B, +/-5): degraded dose f(d d' d'') - f(d) within +/-3 net, falsified at |Delta| >= 10 (three copies of an incomplete plan push the reader to skip, or to complete, the procedure step); slot-count reference f(r1 f1 f2) - f(r1) reported. P6 SEED (Tier N and Tier S). Split-half Spearman reliability of per-item LOO across natural items, Spearman-Brown corrected to the half size, is <= 0.5 at 2 seeds per half (600 items) and reaches >= 0.7 only at 4 seeds per half (Tier S, 300 items). Falsified if 2 seeds per half already give >= 0.7 (two seeds suffice; the seed cost is a footnote). SE ~0.05. Per-set sign reproduction is reported under the pre-registered tie rule (a zero half-mean counts as not reproduced; the tie-excluded rate alongside); if 4 per half is still < 0.7 the seed count reaching 0.7 is reported by Spearman-Brown extrapolation, with the LLM-call cost of LOO (4 runs) versus Shapley (8 runs) at matched reliability. P7 BACKGROUND. I' = the CONFLICT interaction with r3 replaced by a natural cross-type x' (Tier B, +/-5) minus I from P2 (+/-3.5), propagated CI ~+/-6: |I' - I| <= 3 net (dominance is a property of the pair). Falsified if |I' - I| >= 12 net (three-body: whether the wrong item dominates depends on the same-type third item's support for the correct one, as a majority-following reader would give); gap 9 > 6.
Measurement and Noise Control: All contrasts are paired on (game, seed) with identical prompt template, item order and sampling settings; every arm runs on both GPUs. Noise floors: the no-op repeat f(S)' gives the empirical flip rate under no intervention and the null for I via a permutation test that reshuffles which of the two full-set runs is labelled f(S); estimator agreement is computed on disjoint seed halves so LOO and Shapley never share a run (a shared f(S) would cancel out of LOO's argmax and fake a zero floor), with LOO-vs-LOO and Shapley-vs-Shapley on the same halves as the within-estimator floors. Power: per-cell I is bounded in [-2, +2] with SD ~0.7, so Tier A (1,800 cells) gives ~+/-3.5 net, Tier N (1,200) ~+/-4, Tier B (800) ~+/-5 at 95% after cluster bootstrap over games (1,000 resamples); a difference of two class means propagates to ~+/-6. Every equivalence-type prediction (P4, P5, P7) names a pre-registered bound wider than the CI half-width and a falsifier at least one CI width beyond the bound; directional predictions (P2, P3) separate confirm and falsify bands by more than the CI half-width; P1 and P6 state their SEs on 600 items and 100 sets. Tie rules pre-registered: the top item is the strict argmax of the seed-mean; sets tied under either estimator are undetermined, excluded and their fraction reported; a zero half-mean is a non-reproduced sign. Phase 0 gates must pass before any null is interpreted. Seed-count convergence of per-item LOO and of per-class I are reported as estimands (G15); LLM-call cost per unit reliability is stated for LOO (4 runs per set), LOO + pairs (7) and exact Shapley (8), and Shapley needs twice the re-runs of LOO by construction. Static3 (Measurement C) is the anchor: CONFLICT item credits are also reported with static3 present, against the measured k3 - static3 = +17.2 net [+11.9, +22.4]; no prediction here claims that residual vanishes. All credits reported per task type (clean/heat/cool).

For the revised arms: CUE-R's DUPLICATE perturbation (a Q1 result) is the nearest neighbour of the dose arm, in single-shot RAG without a multi-step agent, a content-held-fixed copy count or the k3 - k1 anchor; none of the Q1-Q5 results measures interaction prevalence on a retriever's own sets, cross- versus within-estimator agreement on disjoint seeds, or the seed cost of per-item credit. No pre-emption found; DG-Mem and CUE-R are the papers to position against.
Risk Factors and Limitations: Manufactured items may be unnatural; mitigated by token matching, action-sequence checks and the natural third item, and the headline is on unmanufactured sets. Paraphrase copies may be recognised as near-duplicates, so an inert dose could be deduplication rather than content reading; the exact-duplicate variant is a stated follow-up, not run. vLLM batching makes seeded runs non-deterministic; the no-op repeat and disjoint seed halves measure this rather than assume it. Binary success is coarse and effects may be type-specific (reported per type). Three-item Shapley is a partial view of k=7 sets (2^7 subsets is out of budget; a k=7 extension is future work). The planted conflict item may be too weak or too strong and the rank-1 solo gain beside r3 may fall short; Phase 0 gates both, with a pre-registered fallback (empty third slot) for the gain gate. Equivalence-type predictions (P4, P5, P7) leave an ambiguous zone between bound and falsifier by design. The natural-set prevalence is specific to this retriever, bank and reader; drift and reader swap are not claimed and would need separate arms. Claims are about item classes and the natural distribution, not individual items. Budget is ~35 h on two A100s, above the original 27 h, with a pre-registered cut order.
Addresses gap: G11 (single-removal score checked against exact Shapley, now on the retriever's own sets as the headline) and G12 (harm and help of a co-retrieved item as a function of set composition in a multi-step agent, with copy count as a manipulated composition variable) jointly; G15 (variance and seed cost of per-item estimates via no-op repeats and 8-seed split halves).
Not a restatement of: Brief bullet: "Marginal value of items 2-3 over item 1 ~ +7 net; of items 4-7 ~ +4" (nested-k per-position counterfactual) is an aggregate marginal over natural sets that assumes additivity across positions; this idea manipulates composition, measures the interaction term itself by pairwise removal on the same (game, seed), and asks with a dose arm whether that marginal is content or repetition. Digest card arxiv:2604.05467 (CUE-R): single-shot RAG REMOVE/REPLACE/DUPLICATE without a multi-step agent, a pairwise-removal estimand, or noise and cost; this idea claims the sign of the interaction per class in a multi-step agent, an excess of LOO-vs-Shapley disagreement on natural sets beyond the seed floor, and the seed count for a stable removal rank. Archived counterfactual_memory_screening_under_selection_noise assumed the interference and noise model; here both are measured cells. Sibling masked_harm_pairwise_removal (Stage 2.5 gate): shares the manufactured k=3 conflict/complementary cells and the pairwise-interaction-vs-Shapley logic; it cannot show (a) how often the retriever's own top-3 sets interact, i.e. whether per-item credit is estimator-dependent in the population a memory system actually scores (here the headline, on the natural 2^3 lattice with disjoint-seed estimator agreement), (b) whether the marginal value of items 2-3 is content or repetition (no manipulated copy count), (c) the seed count at which a per-item rank stabilizes and the LLM-call cost of LOO versus Shapley at matched reliability (no 8-seed split halves), or (d) the sign of the conflict cell as a dominance test in which the correct item's rescue of the harmed baseline is a named refuting outcome. The manufactured conflict cell is the one shared design element and is a mechanism cell here, not the claim.
Changes made: Old P1 (REDUNDANT interaction, near_entailed): removed as a prediction, since the OR structure is a consequence of exact copies; replaced by P5 DOSE, a new manipulated variable (copy count with content held fixed: (r1 p1 p2) vs (r1), plus the degraded copy (d d' d'') vs (d) and the slot-count reference (r1 f1 f2)), decoupled from the Phase 0 gate, with absolute thresholds (<= +2 confirm, >= +8 falsify at +/-3.5 net) anchored to the measured k3 - k1 = +8 net; the REDUNDANT set survives only as the Phase 0 paraphrase construction check. Old P2 (CONFLICT, unresolvable): ratio falsifier replaced by absolute thresholds (I <= -8 confirm; I >= 0 falsify) and reframed as a dominance test with two named refuting outcomes (additive reconciliation; correct-item rescue with I ~ +harm); cells raised to 1,800 (+/-3.5 net); position swap added. Old P4 (CONTROL, unresolvable): pre-registered TOST equivalence bound [-6, +6] wider than the +/-3.5 net CI; falsifier moved to |I| >= 9; cells raised to 1,800. Old P5 (estimator, near_entailed): confirmatory claim moved to natural unmanufactured k=3 sets (full 2^3 lattice on 200 games x 6 seeds) and made the headline (new P1); LOO and Shapley computed on disjoint seed halves with within-estimator agreement as the floor, so manufactured redundancy no longer determines the disagreement and the f(S) cancellation in LOO's argmax cannot fake a zero floor; per-class excess (CONFLICT completion on 400 cells) kept as calibration only. Old P6 (seeds, unresolvable): 8 seeds on 100 games so a genuine 4-vs-4 split exists; primary statistic is split-half Spearman of per-item LOO with Spearman-Brown correction (no tie convention needed), and the tie rule for per-set sign reproduction is pre-registered. Old P7 (background, unresolvable): falsifier set above the propagated +/-6 net CI (|I' - I| >= 12 vs <= 3 confirm); the second Phase 4 condition (rank-2 same-type x) dropped for budget. P3 (open): confirm/falsify gap widened (>= +8 vs <= +2) and cells raised to 1,200 (+/-4 net). GATE NOTE: central claim differentiated from masked_harm_pairwise_removal by estimand (natural-set prevalence, disjoint-seed estimator agreement, seed cost) and manipulated variable (copy count); the shared conflict cell is stated as a mechanism cell and what the sibling cannot show is listed in Not a restatement of. Sharpness kept: no prediction was hedged into unfalsifiability, every equivalence claim names a refuting effect size and the arm that produces it, and the natural-set headline is a stronger bet than the manufactured one (interaction must show up in the wild, not only where planted). Budget: 41,400 episodes, ~35 h on two A100s at the measured 20 ep/min, with cell-by-cell arithmetic and a pre-registered cut order back to 27 h; Measurement C's static3 replaces the static-procedure-sentence arm and is applied to the CONFLICT set.
